scope: single Mother trial: Fish delivery receipt after two or more bounded failures
trigger: same bounded task reaches the configured Root Cause Review threshold and later obtains a successful terminal run
assertions: each attempt remains an immutable record bound to runId, jobId, headSha, gate conclusion and failure signature
the terminal success may supersede the current technical gate but must not rewrite or omit prior failures
a separate learning-closure state remains HOLD until the review covers every observed failure signature
each corrective action binds a failure signature to an observed repair delta
the terminal success explicitly retests the covered signatures and names the attempts it supersedes
